parts.text: An IGCSE student is investigating methods of preventing loss of thermal energy. The student is using two beakers labelled A and B , as shown in Fig. 2.1. Fig. 2.1 Beaker A has a layer of insulation and beaker B has a lid but no insulation. The beakers contain hot water at the start of the experiment. The initial temperatures are as shown in Fig. 2.1.

parts.label: a
parts.text: (a) Read, and record in the first row of Table 2.1, the temperatures of the water in beakers A and B at time t = 0. [1]
